name: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Quiver
label: Quest
description: A faded writ requests a Heavy Quiver and gives details for delivery and payment. It can be transferred, but you need to carry it to complete the exchange.
intro: A faded writ requests a Heavy Quiver and gives details for delivery and payment. It can be transferred, but you need to carry it to complete the exchange.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Heavy Quiver, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.
